Description
To commemorate 45 years of Fortuna, PAMP Suisse has created this specially designed and individually serialized 1 oz gold bar. Each bar is crafted with a distinctive proof-like finish, adding to its allure and collectability. With its weight of 1 troy ounce and purity of .9999 fine gold, this bar is a valuable addition to any investment portfolio.
With a distinctive proof-like finish, the Roman goddess of prosperity is portrayed with all her mythical attributes: Sheaves of wheat, poppies, horn of plenty, precious coins, and wheel of fortune. Undoubtedly, the iconic Lady Fortuna is the world’s most recognized and prestigious bullion bar design, produced since 1979! To celebrate 45 years of Fortuna this specially designed and individually serialized 1oz gold bar is limited to a mintage of 4,500, an exceptional collectible.
At Bullion Trading LLC, we proudly offer the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Gold Bar. As a trusted source of precious metals, we ensure that each bar is authentic and comes with its own assay card, guaranteeing its weight and purity. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to own this iconic gold bar and embrace the spirit of fortune.
